newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Tannery optimistic on leather business.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Tannery optimistic on leather business.

text.p: Guangdong Tannery Ltd said on Monday there were good prospects for leather business due to potentially huge demand for leather products in China.

"We are optimistic on the leather business due to a growing consumer spending...in China, and fundamentally huge demand for leather products such as shoes in view of the big population in the country," said chairman Yu Fang.

Guangdong Tannery, leather unit of conglomerate Guangdong Investment Ltd, said in its listing prospectus that China was expected to experience a growth rate of 10 percent per annum in personal spending and that the affluent urban population of 350 million was growing.

Per capita consumption of leather more than doubled from 1987 to 1991, urban households purchased an average of 0.77 pair of shoes per year and the ratio reached 1.08 pairs per year in medium-to-high income families, it said.
Yu said about 50 percent of the company's products were targeted at sino-foreign leather goods manufacturing joint ventures in China on wholesale basis and the balance for export.

"The gross profit margin (of the company) is expected to increase to 20-30 percent in 1997 after the installation of water transfer system (WTS) and expansion of production, from 15-20 percent in 1996," said deputy general manager Kevin Chong.
WTS is a method of processing of cow hide splits by finishing them with polyurethane film.
"About 70 percent of the proceed will be for production expansion and the remaining 30 percent for working capital," Chong added.
Yu said the company will consider diversifying into leather retailing in future but its main focus would be on the production expansion in the short to medium run.
Guangdong Tannery engages in the processing of cow hides and sheep skins, the sale of semi-finished and finished leather.

The company is offering 110 million new shares at HK$1.03 each in public offer in Hong Kong, of which 71 million shares will be offered on a preferential basis to shareholders of Guangdong Investment of one Guangdong Tannery share for every 20 Guangdong Investment shares held.
Guangdong Investment will hold 75 percent of Guangdong Tannery after the issue and listing.
Public offering will run from December 3 to 6 and dealing in the company shares is expected to begin on December 16.
